score_date.note: retained only for backward compatibility; not the sole time semantics

financial_dividend_event_facts.note: fiscal year, event period and method version must be explicit

risk_observations.prohibited_wording: must not describe 2026-08-02 risk conclusions as known as of 2026-07-31

prohibited_time_fallbacks: accept any input available_at > scorecard_formed_at as only a confidence finding
produce a formal shadow scorecard when any input available_at > scorecard_formed_at
report risk_veto_status as a permanent clear when research evidence is absent
claim a 2026-08-02 risk conclusion is known as of 2026-07-31
hardcode scorecard_formed_at without deriving it from the maximum included input available_at

strict_single_point_history_scoring_rule.when: generating a strict single-point 2026-07-31 historical scorecard

scorecard_formed_at_derivation.rule: scorecard_formed_at must equal or be later than the maximum available_at of every included input; it is derived from and verified against the included inputs, not manually hardcoded

identity_inclusion.note: time contract, input identity, scorecard identity and artifact digest must include market_data_as_of_date, research_evidence_as_of, scorecard_formed_at, timezone and time-contract version
